title: Example Set List Response Schema
description: 200 body of GET /api/v1/example-sets after TraigentBackend#3353. The route now returns `response_handler.paginated_response(...)`, whose shape is strict nested-only — {success, message, data: {items, pagination}} (src/utils/response_handler.py:288-296 documents it, :349-356 emits it). Before #3353 the route emitted a top-level `pagination` with a `pages` key and no has_next/has_prev; that form is gone. x-wrap-status: wrapped — this is one of the two enveloped operations in the otherwise-bare `example_set_routes` (see success_envelope_schema.json#/x-wrap-map/mixed). The item shape is ExampleSet.to_dict() (src/models/agent.py:287-305) and is deliberately NOT a $ref to example_set_schema.json: that file's closed resource definition requires only {id, name, description, examples} with additionalProperties:false and declares none of agent_id / example_set_id / tenant_id / project_id / type / selection_method / num_examples / similarity_threshold / tags, so $ref'ing it would declare a contract this serializer violates on every row.

success.description: Discriminator — always true for success responses.

message.description: Human-readable summary; "Example sets retrieved successfully" from this route.

data.description: Nested paginated payload. `pagination` lives HERE, not at the top level — paginated_response is strict nested-only.

pagination.description: Canonical {page, per_page, total, total_pages, has_next, has_prev}. `per_page` is clamped to [1, 100] by the route (MAX_EXAMPLE_SET_PER_PAGE, src/routes/example_set_routes.py:34, 105-108).

SerializedExampleSet.description: Exactly what ExampleSet.to_dict() emits (src/models/agent.py:287-305). Every key is always present; nullability below follows the column definitions at src/models/agent.py:232-266.

example_set_id.description: Backward-compatibility alias emitted alongside `id`, always equal to it (src/models/agent.py:277-285, 291). New consumers read `id`.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Emitted by the serializer; it is the caller's own tenant, never another's, because the list query is tenant- and owner-scoped (src/routes/example_set_routes.py:116-125).

agent_id.description: Parent agent; the only ownership record an example set has.

description.description: Nullable Text column — unlike example_set_schema.json, which requires it.

type.description: Defaults to "input-output" at the column level.

selection_method.description: NOT NULL column; the create route defaults it to "all".

tags.description: Untyped JSON column (JSONType) — the serializer passes it through unchanged, so the wire type is whatever was stored.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 from `datetime.isoformat()` — naive (no timezone offset), because the column is a naive DateTime defaulted with datetime.utcnow. Null only if the attribute is unset.

examples.description: FULL example rows, eagerly serialized for every set in the page (src/models/agent.py:304). This list is NOT paginated here — GET /api/v1/example-sets/{set_id}/examples is the paginated surface.
